items.title: Sanitize path-like/code-like tokens out of the claimsShrinkage scan text before the trigger-word regex runs
items.context: In evaluateDoneIntentEquivalence (packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts ~line 1420-1440), build narrowingText as today, then strip backticked spans (`...`), tokens containing '/' (path segments), and hyphenated or dotted file-name-shaped tokens (e.g. partial-done-recovery.ts, not-covered.md) before testing the claimsShrinkage regex. Plain prose trigger words must keep matching.
items.userSees: A DONE summary whose changes text names core/partial-done-recovery.ts no longer produces the unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage gap, while a prose claim like 'the remaining cases were deferred' still blocks DONE without a confirmed shrinkage decision.

happy.desc: done_intent_equivalence_check on a lightweight-path story whose summary.changes names core/partial-done-recovery.ts reports no unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage gap.

edge.desc: Trigger words inside backticked spans or slash-segmented paths (e.g. `deferred`, src/excluded/list.ts) do not trigger; the same words as plain prose still trigger.

adversarial.desc: A summary that names partial-done-recovery.ts AND separately claims 'remaining scope deferred' in prose still produces the unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage gap - the sanitizer must not swallow surrounding prose or become a bypass for genuine shrinkage claims.

verificationEvidence.note: GREEN smoke assertion: a summary whose changes text names core/partial-done-recovery.ts produces no unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage gap (fileNameDone case added for B-2c03).

GREEN smoke assertion: backticked `deferred` span and slash path src/excluded/list.ts do not trigger the gap (codeTokenDone case), while the same words as prose still trigger (proseShrinkDone/narrowLightDone controls).

GREEN smoke assertion: a genuine prose shrinkage claim next to a path token (Fixed core/partial-done-recovery.ts; the remaining cases were deferred...) STILL produces the gap — sanitizer does not swallow surrounding prose (proseShrinkDone case).

items.title: Add a repro-first regression test where the summary names partial-done-recovery.ts
items.context: Repro-first (guide-red-spike-story): add the smoke case to proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts BEFORE the fix and record it failing against the current heuristic, then make it pass. The case writes a lightweight-path story whose summary.changes names core/partial-done-recovery.ts and asserts done_intent_equivalence_check emits no unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage gap; keep the existing positive control (prose 'Partial narrower delivery; remaining cases deferred.') asserting the gap still fires.
items.userSees: npm run test:proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke passes and includes a case proving file-name-only summaries do not trip the shrinkage gap.

happy.desc: New smoke case passes after the fix; full proofstory-intent-hardening smoke stays green.

edge.desc: The pre-fix RED run is captured as evidence showing the new case fails against the unpatched heuristic.

adversarial.desc: Existing narrow-delivery positive control still fails the gate (guard not weakened by the sanitizer).

verificationEvidence.note: Full proofstory-intent-hardening smoke passes post-fix including the new B-2c03 regression cases; exit 0, final line: ProofStory intent hardening smoke passed.

Pre-fix RED captured: same command failed with AssertionError 'a summary naming core/partial-done-recovery.ts is not a shrinkage claim (B-d6a0 false positive)' at baseline head 2db38feff1; bound in red-evidence.json (target regression-test-filename-summary:happy, greenRelation same_acceptance).

Guard not weakened: existing narrow-delivery positive control (acceptanceVerdict partial + 'Partial narrower delivery; remaining cases deferred.') still yields done_summary_not_accepted/unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage (narrowLightDone), and proseShrinkDone still fires next to a path token.

items.title: Decide and document whether the bare trigger word 'remaining' is too broad
items.context: An earlier B-d6a0 summary draft tripped the heuristic on 'remaining' while describing pre-existing unrelated suite failures. Evaluate keeping, narrowing (e.g. only match shrinkage-flavored phrases like 'remaining work/items/scope'), or dropping it; record the decision and rationale in the story plan/summary, and if the vocabulary changes, cover the change with a smoke assertion.
items.userSees: The story artifacts contain an explicit keep/narrow/drop decision for 'remaining' with rationale; if narrowed, a smoke case shows the narrowed behavior.

happy.desc: Decision recorded; heuristic behavior matches the recorded decision.

edge.desc: If narrowed: 'the remaining suite failures are pre-existing' no longer triggers while 'remaining scope deferred' still does.

adversarial.desc: If kept: rationale explains why the false-positive rate is acceptable rather than silently ignoring the question.

verificationEvidence.note: Decision NARROW implemented: bare 'remaining' no longer matches; 'remaining <scope-noun>' (work/scope/items/cases/tasks/milestones/features/functionality/coverage/requirements/deliverables) still matches. Smoke asserts both directions (preexistingDone=no gap, remainingScopeDone=gap).

Edge pair covered in smoke: 'Two remaining suite failures are pre-existing upstream issues' does NOT trigger (preexistingDone); 'The remaining cases were left for a follow-up story' DOES trigger (remainingScopeDone).

Keep/narrow/drop decision documented with rationale in plan.md (CHK-003 decision section): narrow chosen; keep rejected (preserves known false-positive class), drop rejected (loses real signal); recall-loss argument recorded.
